$comment: Demo Lua automation scripts. triggerType follows App.Shared.Lua.Models.LuaScriptTriggerType (0 Manual, 1 TelemetryChange, 2 MachineStateChange, 3 SlaPreventiveCheck, 4 UiExtension, 5 Scheduled). Scripts are stored in the backend's in-memory LuaAutomationService (not in PostgreSQL), so they are (re)registered with `just demo-runtime` after every backend start. Ids are deterministic demo UUIDs derived from '_key'.

scripts.name: NV Demo - Telemetry Threshold & Drift Watchdog
scripts.description: Moving-average limit check with time-to-alarm projection for laser power, glass temperature, resin flow and spindle vibration. Creates at most one ticket per machine and alarm code.

scripts.name: NV Demo - SLA Risk Report
scripts.description: Read-only report of breached and at-risk unresolved tickets using tickets.check_sla.

scripts.name: NV Demo - Laser Fleet UI Extensions
scripts.description: Registers a Laser Fleet badge, a dashboard banner and a read-only 'Laser health snapshot' machine action.
